# Diogo Fitness

> Diogo Fitness is one-to-one online fitness coaching from Diogo Camera, based in South Florida, for clients anywhere in the world.

Coaching is online and sold only through a conversation: there are no prices on this site. Apply at https://diogofit.com/apply/.

## Pages

- [Diogo Camera, Online Fitness Coach](https://diogofit.com/about/): Diogo Camera is an online fitness coach based in South Florida. He used to build his days around comfort. Now he helps people build theirs around structure.
- [Apply for Online Coaching](https://diogofit.com/apply/): Apply for online fitness coaching with Diogo: answer a few short questions and send him the message on Instagram, or use the full application form.
- [Online Fitness Coaching With Diogo Camera](https://diogofit.com/coaching/): Online fitness coaching built around your week, wherever you live: workouts in Trainerize, two weigh-ins a week, a weekly call and direct access to Diogo.

- [Online Fitness Coaching for Busy People](https://diogofit.com/coaching/busy-week/): Online fitness coaching built for a week that never holds still: two or three sessions you can keep, a floor for bad weeks, and a coach who adjusts the plan.
- [Online Fat Loss Coaching That Fits Your Life](https://diogofit.com/coaching/fat-loss/): Online fat loss coaching without extreme diets: lifting to keep muscle, steps and habits you can repeat, and numbers someone reads every week.

## Articles

- [How to Stop Starting Over With Fitness](https://diogofit.com/learn/why-you-keep-starting-over/): Starting over usually isn't a willpower problem. It's a system problem: decide ahead, shrink the plan for bad weeks, never miss twice, have a witness.
- [What Is Online Fitness Coaching? How It Works](https://diogofit.com/learn/what-is-online-fitness-coaching/): Online coaching is a personalized training plan on your phone, with practical nutrition guidance and a real coach checking in weekly. How it works and who it's for.
- [How to Pick an Online Fitness Coach (7 Checks)](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-to-choose-an-online-fitness-coach/): Seven things to check before you hire an online fitness coach: whether they ask about your life first, how they track progress, how often you'll talk and what they promise.
- [How to Stay Consistent With Working Out](https://diogofit.com/learn/consistency-vs-motivation/): Motivation comes and goes, so plan for the days you don't feel like it: set days and times, a smaller workout on bad days, and never miss twice.
- [How Long to See Results From Working Out?](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-long-to-see-results/): For most people: strength usually improves first, measurable muscle around weeks 4 to 8, and visible fat loss often takes 8 to 12 weeks or more.
- [Can You Lose Fat and Build Muscle at Once?](https://diogofit.com/learn/body-recomposition/): Losing fat and building muscle at the same time is realistic for more people than you'd think. What body recomposition takes: protein, lifting, a small deficit and time.
- [How Much Protein and How Many Calories?](https://diogofit.com/learn/calories-and-protein/): If you lift, aim for 0.7 to 1 gram of protein per pound of bodyweight a day. For calories, estimate your maintenance, pick a direction and adjust.
- [What Is the 80/20 Rule for Eating?](https://diogofit.com/learn/eighty-twenty-eating/): About 80% of what you eat is filling, protein-rich, mostly unprocessed food. The other 20% is food you simply enjoy. Calories and protein still count.
- [How Often Should You Work Out?](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-often-to-train/): Once a week beats none. General fitness and fat loss are happy on two or three days a week. Pick the schedule you can repeat, then make it count.
- [Progressive Overload, Explained Simply](https://diogofit.com/learn/progressive-overload/): Progressive overload means asking a little more of your muscles over time: more weight, reps or sets. How to apply it, how fast to add weight and what to do when you stall.
- [Why Am I Not Losing Weight? 6 Common Reasons](https://diogofit.com/learn/why-you-cant-lose-fat/): Eating healthy but not losing weight? Six things I'd check first: portions, underestimated intake, weekends, steps, consistency and one-day weigh-ins.
- [How Many Steps a Day for Fat Loss?](https://diogofit.com/learn/walking-for-fat-loss/): Don't jump to a big number. Start from the steps you already average, add a bit and hold it until it feels routine. Then raise it.
- [What Is RIR (Reps in Reserve)?](https://diogofit.com/learn/reps-in-reserve/): Reps in reserve (RIR) is how many more good reps you could have done before failure. For most working sets, aim for about 1 to 3 in reserve.
- [How to Get Back Into the Gym After a Long Break](https://diogofit.com/learn/getting-back-into-training/): After months off you keep more than you think, mostly strength. Start lighter than your old numbers, train two or three times a week and build back over six weeks.
- [Is an Online Fitness Coach Worth It?](https://diogofit.com/learn/is-online-fitness-coaching-worth-it/): An honest answer from a coach: what an online fitness coach adds, what the research shows, and who should wait before hiring one.
- [Online Fitness Coach vs Personal Trainer](https://diogofit.com/learn/online-coach-vs-gym-trainer/): A personal trainer works beside you in sessions. An online coach plans your whole week. How to choose, and when a trainer is the better call.
- [Gym Anxiety? How to Get Through Your First Day](https://diogofit.com/learn/gym-anxiety/): Nervous about your first day at the gym? Decide the workout first, keep it short and easy, know the etiquette basics and have a plan for when you feel watched.
- [How to Start Lifting Weights: First 4 Weeks](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-to-start-lifting-weights/): A beginner's first four weeks of lifting: six movements, two or three short sessions a week, weights that feel too easy, and exactly when to add more.
- [Your First Month of Online Coaching](https://diogofit.com/learn/first-month-of-online-coaching/): The first month of online fitness coaching, week by week: the questions, the first plan, the first weigh-ins, the first call, and what usually feels hard.
- [How Active Is Your State? The CDC Numbers](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-active-is-your-state/): Every state and DC in one table: the share of adults who report no leisure-time activity and the share who lift two or more days a week, from the CDC's state survey.
